description: Post a Markdown discussion message. Requires write permission and acts as the API key creator. May send email, mention notifications and Slack messages. Repeating a call creates another message.

url.description: Private gs:// URL returned by prepare_finding_attachment_upload after uploading the file.

bodyMd.description: Markdown body. Mention syntax: @[Label](USER:id), @[Label](OPERATOR:id), @[ODI-12](FINDING:id), or @[Pentest](PENTEST:id); use list_finding_mentionables to discover IDs.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

threadId.description: Existing block to reply to; omit for the native discussion.

name: create_finding_message
title: Post a finding discussion message
